lead.headline: Irish tech union grows five-fold amid AI-driven layoffs
lead.standfirst: While Dublin hosted the presidency’s International AI Summit, a Workers’ AI Counter Summit met the weekend before, Politico Europe reports.
body: The Digital and Techworker Alliance, founded in 2023, had around 270 members in its first year and a half and now has more than 1,350, its organiser told the outlet.
lead.more: Irish tech workers unionise as AI-driven layoffs spread (Politico Europe).

five.headline: From the archive: how qualifications govern access to occupations
body: Qualifications define what a person needs to know and be able to do to carry out an activity on the labour market. Health and safety, consumer protection and quality assurance are quoted to justify them, but they may also defend the private interests of professional groups, the study notes.
five.more: From the archive (2013): the role of qualifications in governing occupations.

five.headline: From the archive: tracking digital skill needs in online job ads
five.standfirst: A Cedefop policy brief dated 20 October 2023.
body: Using Cedefop analysis of online job advertisements, it showed the demand for digital skills across the EU-27 and argued for faster implementation of digital policy and for up- and reskilling.
five.more: From the archive (2023): Going digital means skilling for digital.

five.headline: Chile’s TVET schools turn one internship policy into many
five.standfirst: Interviews with 37 internship coordinators show schools reading the policy either as competency validation or as a route to employability.
body: Those readings shape which students go to which workplaces; engaging employers is a recurring barrier.
five.more: Chile: how TVET schools enact internship policy (Education + Training).

five.headline: ELA brings seven countries together on disguised job placement
five.standfirst: Authorities from Belgium, Czechia, Germany, the Netherlands, Lithuania, Slovakia and Finland met in Prague on 6–7 October.
body: An ELA study on temporary work agencies and other forms of employment intermediation is expected in early 2027.
five.more: ELA: seven countries compare tools against disguised job placement.

five.headline: Teachers and trainers are key agents of change, says the ETF
five.standfirst: As AI and the green transition reshape labour markets, the ETF argues for investing in the educators who support young people and adults throughout their learning.
five.more: ETF: why investing in teachers and trainers matters.

more.headline: HR professionals see AI reshaping their roles more than taking jobs
more.standfirst: Their insecurity is mostly about changing role expectations rather than job loss, and self-directed workplace learning helps them regain agency.
more.more: AI and HR professionals: workplace learning as a buffer (Journal of Workplace Learning).

more.headline: Cedefop describes Ireland’s further education and training system
more.standfirst: A new short description covers VET for learners aged 16+ and adults, delivered mainly through 16 education and training boards.
body: It highlights the dual apprenticeship model, tertiary degrees linking further and higher education, and microqualifications under the Skills to Advance initiative.
more.more: VET in Ireland: Cedefop short description and Spotlight.

lives.headline: German concrete builders win world gold after training around their jobs
lives.standfirst: Jakob Distler and Tim Arnold beat eight teams in concrete construction at WorldSkills 2026 in Shanghai.
body: Four days at their physical limit, they told the Deutsche Handwerks Zeitung; when the concrete for a staircase came out far too liquid, they formed a lid over the step and still finished on time. They trained from April, every two to three weeks with their national trainer in Nördlingen and on evenings at home, with their bosses giving them the time. Their Chinese rivals, they observed, train for years. Now, they say, they pass their enthusiasm for the trade on to the new apprentices.
